rules.title: Move Azure Storage to an approved private-access path
rules.change: Add a Private Endpoint and private DNS association, then disable public network access after consumer-path validation.
tests: Resolve the storage FQDN from every approved network

rules.title: Restrict unintended S3 public access
rules.change: Enable account/bucket public-access controls only after identifying intended public distribution and replacing it with an approved delivery path where required.

rules.title: Enforce approved Cloud Storage access
rules.change: Enable Public Access Prevention and remove broad IAM members after validating intended public delivery and service identities.

rules.title: Remove unnecessary privileged execution
rules.change: Set a least-privilege security context and admission policy while preserving explicitly justified system workloads.
tests: Run workload functional and startup tests
Validate required device and filesystem access
Exercise admission policy in audit mode

rules.title: Enable a bounded provider-native audit-log pipeline
rules.change: Enable required management and data-plane logs with explicit scope, filters, retention, routing and cost alerts.
tests: Generate and locate a canary event
Measure seven-day ingestion before approving the forecast
